heading: Founded by Mr. Unus Shalim in 1989, our journey began with a simple vision—to create high-quality packaging solutions that businesses could trust. Over the decades, we have crafted thousands of custom packaging products, built lasting relationships with our clients, and continuously evolved with changing market needs. Today, we proudly carry forward the same commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction
introduction: At Box Wale, we specialize in manufacturing premium packaging solutions that help businesses create unforgettable first impressions. From luxury gift boxes to durable corrugated packaging, every product is crafted with precision, creativity, and uncompromising quality.
mission: Our mission is to provide innovative, sustainable, and premium packaging solutions that enhance product presentation while strengthening our clients' brand identity.
experience: With years of expertise in the packaging industry, we have successfully delivered customized packaging solutions for startups, retailers, corporate brands, and e-commerce businesses across India.
